sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful for COMPLEX_READINESS: it targets the supplied ship owner, represents all declared operands and results with the canonical terms, uses correct QUDT quantity-node structures and units, encodes required vertical and horizontal case categories, and preserves the conditional paired loadPatchLength/iceLoadAreaFactorCa case requirement without inventing formula execution.

rows:
Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF030DirectAnalysisCaseShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF030LoadLengthCaseShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF030ShipShape
Semantic validator feedback: Replace the three invented canonical shape IRIs nltl:TRF030ShipShape, nltl:TRF030DirectAnalysisCaseShape, and nltl:TRF030LoadLengthCaseShape with blank-node SHACL shapes (or otherwise non-vocabulary shape identifiers). Extend each directAnalysisCase to encode the required load-location semantics rather than only arbitrary numeric positions: include the supplied verticalLoadPositionType and horizontalLoadPositionType controlled properties with the applicable alternatives, and represent the UIWL, LIWL, intermediate vertical locations, and mid-span/spacing-centered horizontal locations using the supplied canonical terms and corresponding evidence. Require the supplied ship-owned spacing and span quantities, and include the required upper/lower ice-waterline reference positions where those positions are represented on cases. Preserve the conditional branch requiring paired loadPatchLength and iceLoadAreaFactorCa on several distinct shared case nodes only when load length is not determined from the arrangement. Do not add formula execution or an invented 1.8 multiplier under COMPLEX_READINESS; appliedIcePressure may remain a readiness result with its declared MPa unit.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Quantity property icePressure must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property appliedIcePressure must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property loadPatchHeight must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property spacing must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property span must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property loadPatchLength must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property iceLoadAreaFactorCa must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property verticalLoadPosition must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property horizontalLoadPosition must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property upperIceWaterlineReferencePosition must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype | Quantity property lowerIceWaterlineReferencePosition must point to a QUDT QuantityValue node, not a direct literal datatype
Semantic validator feedback: Deterministic validation is invalid. For every quantity-valued property, remove sh:datatype qudt:QuantityValue from the outer property shape and constrain its values as QUDT QuantityValue nodes (for example with sh:class qudt:QuantityValue together with the existing sh:node structure). Correct every unit IRI from the qudt schema namespace to the supplied QUDT unit namespace: use http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA, http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/M, and http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS. Preserve the earlier blank-node/non-vocabulary shape repair. Semantically, minCount 2 with an unconstrained alternative does not ensure representation of the required UIWL-centered case, the half-load-height-below-LIWL case, and intermediate vertical cases, nor does it ensure several horizontal cases including a mid-span-or-spacing-centered case; add bounded qualified case constraints for those required categories while keeping each case as the pairing node for conditional loadPatchLength and iceLoadAreaFactorCa.

The candidate is semantically faithful for COMPLEX_READINESS: it targets the supplied ship owner, represents all declared operands and results with the canonical terms, uses correct QUDT quantity-node structures and units, encodes required vertical and horizontal case categories, and preserves the conditional paired loadPatchLength/iceLoadAreaFactorCa case requirement without inventing formula execution.
